## Key Projects

### Distributed Document Search
- **Repository**: https://github.com/achhayapathak/distributed-document-search
- **Technologies**: TypeScript, Distributed Systems, Multi-tenancy, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Redis, AWS
- **Description**: Production-grade distributed search service demonstrating multi-tenancy, asynchronous message processing with Kafka, Redis caching, and full-text search indexing across millions of documents with sub-200ms query latency.

### Job Assist AI
- **Repository**: https://github.com/achhayapathak/job-assist-ai-backend
- **Technologies**: TypeScript, Agentic AI, Automation, LLMs, Next.js
- **Description**: Agentic AI tool that ingests candidate resumes, crawls the web for matching opportunities, extracts recruiter contact details, and dynamically synthesizes tailored ATS-friendly resumes for job applications.

### Event Aggregation Engine
- **Repository**: https://github.com/joinupdev
- **Technologies**: Python, Agentic AI, RabbitMQ, Firecrawl, Redis, VectorDB
- **Description**: Autonomous crawler and aggregation engine that monitors dozens of event platforms, deduplicating and structuring event data into standardized schemas.
